Who runs this Koh Samui guide and booking site? | Mea and an Australian-Thai team who have organised island trips on Koh Samui and Koh Phangan since 2006. The same team runs kohphangan.com, angthongmarinepark.com, pigislandkohsamui.com and speedboatsamui.com, so you get one booking system, one cancellation policy and one WhatsApp number, +66 63 704 0888, across all four sites and this one.
Are you a licensed tour operator? | Yes. We hold Tourism Authority of Thailand licence 43/01467. Bookings are paid by card through a secure checkout and charged in Thai baht, with EUR and USD shown for reference only. Day trips are fully refundable when you cancel 48 hours or more before departure, and the full rules are on our terms and cancellation page.
Do you run your own boats? | We plan and manage every trip we sell, from your booking and hotel pickup to the boat, the itinerary and the return transfer. Trips run with licensed local boats and crews we select and brief, and our cancellation policy, pickup and WhatsApp support apply whoever is at the wheel. If you want a specific boat type, ask about a private speedboat or longtail.
Where is your office on Koh Samui? | Our Koh Samui office is on Chaweng Beach Road in Bo Phut (postcode 84320), on the east coast of the island. It is a working booking desk rather than a walk-in shop, so message us on WhatsApp before you visit. WhatsApp support runs daily from 08:00 to 20:00 Thailand time, and most bookings never need an office visit.
How do you check the information in your guides? | We check facts against primary sources: Thai government and national park pages, operators' own timetables and our own boat crews. Prices and dates on booking pages are reviewed monthly and events weekly. Every page shows an Updated date, and anything we cannot confirm stays off the page. Our editorial policy page explains the full process.
How can I report an error on this site? | Send the page link and what is wrong to WhatsApp +66 63 704 0888 or to the email address on our Contact page. We check the point against a primary source, correct the page if you are right and update its date. We do not accept paid corrections, sponsored changes or requests to remove honest warnings about prices, scams or safety.
